items.source: The JMS destination type for responses: queue or topic. The default is the value of the destination-type attribute.
items.translation: JMS 响应目标类型：queue 或 topic。默认值为 destination-type 属性的值。

items.source: Exposes the settings defined by this element as a JmsListenerContainerFactory with the specified id so that they can be reused with other endpoints.
items.translation: 将此元素定义的设置暴露为具有指定id的JmsListenerContainerFactory，以便可与其他端点一起重用。

items.source:
The maximum number of messages to load into a single session. Note that raising this
  number might lead to starvation of concurrent consumers.
items.translation: 加载到单个会话中的最大消息数。请注意，提高此数值可能会导致并发消费者发生饥饿。

items.source: The JMS destination type for this listener: queue, topic, durableTopic, sharedTopic, or sharedDurableTopic. This potentially enables the pubSubDomain, subscriptionDurable and subscriptionShared properties of the container. The default is queue (which disables those three properties).
items.translation: 此监听器的 JMS 目标类型：queue、topic、durableTopic、sharedTopic 或 sharedDurableTopic。这可能会启用容器的 pubSubDomain、subscriptionDurable 和 subscriptionShared 属性。默认值为 queue（这将禁用这三个属性）。

items.source: The JMS destination type for this listener: queue, topic, durableTopic, sharedTopic. or sharedDurableTopic. This potentially enables the pubSubDomain, subscriptionDurable, and subscriptionShared properties of the container. The default is queue (which disables those three properties).
items.translation: 此监听器的 JMS 目标类型：queue、topic、durableTopic、sharedTopic，或 sharedDurableTopic。这可能会启用容器的 pubSubDomain、subscriptionDurable 和 subscriptionShared 属性。默认值为 queue（这将禁用这三个属性）。

items.source: The namespace consists of three top-level elements: <annotation-driven/>, <listener-container/> and <jca-listener-container/>. <annotation-driven/> enables the use of annotation-driven listener endpoints . <listener-container/> and <jca-listener-container/> define shared listener container configuration and can contain <listener/> child elements. The following example shows a basic configuration for two listeners:
items.translation: 命名空间包含三个顶级元素：<annotation-driven/>、<listener-container/> 和 <jca-listener-container/>。<annotation-driven/> 启用了基于注解的监听器端点的使用。<listener-container/> 和 <jca-listener-container/> 定义共享的监听器容器配置，并可包含 <listener/> 子元素。以下示例展示了两个监听器的基本配置：

items.source: The cache level for JMS resources: none, connection, session, consumer, or auto. By default (auto), the cache level is effectively consumer, unless an external transaction manager has been specified — in which case, the effective default will be none (assuming Jakarta EE-style transaction management, where the given ConnectionFactory is an XA-aware pool).
items.translation: JMS 资源的缓存级别：none、connection、session、consumer 或 auto。默认情况下 (auto)，缓存级别实际上为 consumer，除非已指定外部事务管理器——在这种情况下，实际默认值将为 none（假设采用 Jakarta EE 风格的事务管理，其中给定的 ConnectionFactory 是一个 XA 感知池）。

items.source: The native JMS acknowledge mode: auto, client, dups-ok, or transacted. A value of transacted activates a locally transacted Session. As an alternative, you can specify the transaction-manager attribute, described later in table. The default is auto.
items.translation: 原生 JMS 确认模式：auto、client、dups-ok 或 transacted。值为 transacted 会激活本地事务性 Session。作为替代，您可以指定稍后在表中描述的 transaction-manager 属性。默认值为 auto。

items.source: The native JMS acknowledge mode: auto, client, dups-ok, or transacted. A value of transacted activates a locally transacted Session. As an alternative, you can specify the transaction-manager attribute described later. The default is auto.
items.translation: 原生 JMS 确认模式：auto、client、dups-ok 或 transacted。值为 transacted 时，会激活本地事务性 Session。作为替代方案，您可以指定后面描述的 transaction-manager 属性。默认值为 auto。

items.source: The type of this listener container. The available options are default, simple, default102, or simple102 (the default option is default).
items.translation: 此监听器容器的类型。可用选项为default、simple、default102或simple102（默认选项为default）。

items.source: Specifies the BackOff instance to use to compute the interval between recovery attempts. If the BackOffExecution implementation returns BackOffExecution#STOP, the listener container does not further try to recover. The recovery-interval value is ignored when this property is set. The default is a FixedBackOff with an interval of 5000 milliseconds (that is, five seconds).
items.translation: 指定用于计算恢复尝试之间间隔的BackOff实例。如果BackOffExecution实现返回BackOffExecution#STOP，则监听器容器不再尝试恢复。设置此属性时，忽略recovery-interval值。默认值为一个间隔为 5000 毫秒（即五秒）的FixedBackOff。

items.source: The preceding example is equivalent to creating two distinct listener container bean definitions and two distinct MessageListenerAdapter bean definitions, as shown in Using MessageListenerAdapter. In addition to the attributes shown in the preceding example, the listener element can contain several optional ones. The following table describes all of the available attributes:
items.translation: 前面的示例等同于创建两个不同的监听器容器 Bean 定义和两个不同的MessageListenerAdapter Bean 定义，如使用 MessageListenerAdapter中所示。除了前面示例中显示的属性外，listener元素还可以包含几个可选的属性。下表描述了所有可用的属性：

items.source: The number of concurrent sessions or consumers to start for each listener. It can either be a simple number indicating the maximum number (for example, 5) or a range indicating the lower as well as the upper limit (for example, 3-5). Note that a specified minimum is just a hint and might be ignored at runtime. The default is 1. You should keep concurrency limited to 1 in case of a topic listener or if queue ordering is important. Consider raising it for general queues.
items.translation: 每个监听器要启动的并发会话或消费者数量。它可以是一个表示最大数量的简单数字（例如，5），或者是一个表示下限和上限的范围（例如，3-5）。请注意，指定的最小值只是一个提示，运行时可能会被忽略。默认值为 1。如果是主题监听器或队列顺序很重要时，应将并发限制为 1。对于普通队列，可以考虑提高该值。

items.source: A reference to the JmsActivationSpecFactory. The default is to autodetect the JMS provider and its ActivationSpec class (see DefaultJmsActivationSpecFactory).
items.translation: 对 JmsActivationSpecFactory 的引用。默认行为是自动检测 JMS 提供者及其 ActivationSpec 类（参见 DefaultJmsActivationSpecFactory）。

items.source: The name of the handler method to invoke. If the ref attribute points to a MessageListener or Spring SessionAwareMessageListener, you can omit this attribute.
items.translation: 要调用的处理器方法名称。如果ref属性指向MessageListener或 Spring SessionAwareMessageListener，则可以省略此属性。

items.source: The <listener-container/> element also accepts several optional attributes. This allows for customization of the various strategies (for example, taskExecutor and destinationResolver) as well as basic JMS settings and resource references. By using these attributes, you can define highly-customized listener containers while still benefiting from the convenience of the namespace.
items.translation: <listener-container/> 元素还支持几个可选属性。这允许自定义各种策略（例如 taskExecutor 和 destinationResolver）以及基本的 JMS 设置和资源引用。通过使用这些属性，您可以定义高度定制的监听器容器，同时仍能受益于命名空间的便利性。

items.source: You can automatically expose such settings as a JmsListenerContainerFactory by specifying the id of the bean to expose through the factory-id attribute, as the following example shows:
items.translation: 您可以通过在factory-id属性中指定要暴露的 Bean 的id，自动将此类设置暴露为JmsListenerContainerFactory，如下例所示：

items.source: A custom listener container implementation class as a fully qualified class name. The default is Spring’s standard DefaultMessageListenerContainer or SimpleMessageListenerContainer, according to the container-type attribute.
items.translation: 作为完全限定类名的自定义监听器容器实现类。默认情况下，根据container-type属性，使用 Spring 的标准的DefaultMessageListenerContainer或SimpleMessageListenerContainer。

items.source: A reference to an external PlatformTransactionManager (typically an XA-based transaction coordinator, such as Spring’s JtaTransactionManager). If not specified, native acknowledging is used (see the acknowledge attribute).
items.translation: 对外部PlatformTransactionManager（通常是基于 XA 的事务协调器，例如 Spring 的JtaTransactionManager）的引用。如果未指定，则使用原生确认模式（参见acknowledge属性）。

items.source: A reference to a Spring JtaTransactionManager or a jakarta.transaction.TransactionManager for kicking off an XA transaction for each incoming message. If not specified, native acknowledging is used (see the acknowledge attribute).
items.translation: 对 Spring JtaTransactionManager 或 jakarta.transaction.TransactionManager 的引用，用于为每条传入消息启动 XA 事务。如果未指定，则使用原生确认机制（参见 acknowledge 属性）。

items.source: The name of the default response destination to which to send response messages. This is applied in case of a request message that does not carry a JMSReplyTo field. The type of this destination is determined by the listener-container’s response-destination-type attribute. Note that this applies only to a listener method with a return value, for which each result object is converted into a response message.
items.translation: 默认响应消息发送目的地的名称。如果请求消息未携带 JMSReplyTo 字段，则应用此设置。该目的地的类型由监听器容器的 response-destination-type 属性决定。请注意，这仅适用于具有返回值的监听器方法，其中每个结果对象都会被转换为响应消息。

items.source: The number of concurrent sessions or consumers to start for this listener. This value can either be a simple number indicating the maximum number (for example, 5) or a range indicating the lower as well as the upper limit (for example, 3-5). Note that a specified minimum is only a hint and might be ignored at runtime. The default is the value provided by the container.
items.translation: 此监听器要启动的并发会话或消费者数量。该值可以是一个表示最大数量的简单数字（例如，5），或者是一个表示下限和上限的范围（例如，3-5）。请注意，指定的最小值仅作为提示，运行时可能会被忽略。默认值为容器提供的值。

items.source: The following table describes all available attributes. See the class-level javadoc of the AbstractMessageListenerContainer and its concrete subclasses for more details on the individual properties. The javadoc also provides a discussion of transaction choices and message redelivery scenarios.
items.translation: 下表描述了所有可用的属性。有关各个属性的详细信息，请参阅 AbstractMessageListenerContainer 的类级别 Javadoc 及其具体子类。Javadoc 还提供了有关事务选择和消息重发场景的讨论。

items.source: A reference to the JMS ConnectionFactory bean (the default bean name is connectionFactory).
items.translation: 对 JMS ConnectionFactory Bean 的引用（默认 Bean 名称为 connectionFactory）。

items.source: A reference to the DestinationResolver strategy for resolving JMS Destination instances.
items.translation: 对用于解析 JMSDestination 实例的DestinationResolver策略的引用。

items.source: A reference to the MessageConverter strategy for converting JMS Messages to listener method arguments. The default is a SimpleMessageConverter.
items.translation: 用于将 JMS 消息转换为监听器方法参数的 MessageConverter 策略引用。默认值为 SimpleMessageConverter。

items.source: A reference to an ErrorHandler strategy for handling any uncaught exceptions that may occur during the execution of the MessageListener.
items.translation: 对在执行MessageListener期间可能发生的任何未捕获异常的处理 ErrorHandler 策略的引用。

items.source: The timeout (in milliseconds) to use for receive calls. The default is 1000 (one second). -1 indicates no timeout.
items.translation: 接收调用使用的超时时间（以毫秒为单位）。默认值为 1000（一秒）。-1 表示无超时。

items.source: Specifies the interval between recovery attempts, in milliseconds. It offers a convenient way to create a FixedBackOff with the specified interval. For more recovery options, consider specifying a BackOff instance instead. The default is 5000 milliseconds (that is, five seconds).
items.translation: 指定重试间隔（以毫秒为单位）。它提供了一种方便的方式来创建具有指定间隔的FixedBackOff。对于更多恢复选项，请考虑指定一个BackOff实例。默认值为 5000 毫秒（即五秒）。

items.source: A reference to the JCA ResourceAdapter bean (the default bean name is resourceAdapter).
items.translation: 对 JCA ResourceAdapter Bean 的引用（默认 Bean 名称为resourceAdapter）。

items.source: A reference to the DestinationResolver strategy for resolving JMS Destinations.
items.translation: 对用于解析 JMS Destinations 的 DestinationResolver 策略的引用。

items.source: A reference to the MessageConverter strategy for converting JMS Messages to listener method arguments. The default is SimpleMessageConverter.
items.translation: 用于将 JMS 消息转换为监听器方法参数的 MessageConverter 策略引用。默认值为 SimpleMessageConverter。

items.source: The number of concurrent sessions or consumers to start for each listener. It can either be a simple number indicating the maximum number (for example 5) or a range indicating the lower as well as the upper limit (for example, 3-5). Note that a specified minimum is only a hint and is typically ignored at runtime when you use a JCA listener container. The default is 1.
items.translation: 每个监听器要启动的并发会话或消费者数量。它可以是一个表示最大数量的简单数字（例如 5），或者是一个表示下限和上限的范围（例如，3-5）。请注意，指定的最小值仅作为提示，在使用 JCA 监听器容器时通常在运行时会被忽略。默认值为 1。

items.source: The destination name for this listener, resolved through the DestinationResolver strategy.
items.translation: 此监听器的目标名称，通过 DestinationResolver 策略解析。

items.source: A reference to the Spring TaskExecutor for the JMS listener invokers.
items.translation: 对 JMS 监听器调用器的 Spring TaskExecutor 引用。

items.source: The lifecycle phase within which this container should start and stop. The lower the value, the earlier this container starts and the later it stops. The default is Integer.MAX_VALUE, meaning that the container starts as late as possible and stops as soon as possible.
items.translation: 此容器应启动和停止的生命周期阶段。数值越低，该容器启动越早且停止越晚。默认值为Integer.MAX_VALUE，表示该容器尽可能晚地启动并尽可能早地停止。

items.source: Configuring a JCA-based listener container with the jms schema support is very similar, as the following example shows:
items.translation: 配置支持 jms 模式的基于 JCA 的监听器容器非常相似，如下例所示：

items.source:
Spring provides an XML namespace for simplifying JMS configuration. To use the JMS
namespace elements, you need to reference the JMS schema, as the following example shows:
items.translation: Spring 提供了一个用于简化 JMS 配置的 XML 命名空间。要使用 JMS 命名空间元素，您需要引用 JMS 模式，如下例所示：

items.source:
A bean name for the hosting listener container. If not specified, a bean name is
  automatically generated.
items.translation: 托管监听器容器的 Bean 名称。如果未指定，则自动生成一个 Bean 名称。

items.source: The bean name of the handler object.
items.translation: 处理器的 Bean 名称。

items.source: The name of the durable subscription, if any.
items.translation: 持久化订阅的名称（如果有）。

items.source: An optional message selector for this listener.
items.translation: 此监听器的可选消息选择器。

items.source:
The JMS client ID for this listener container. You must specify it when you use
  durable subscriptions.
items.translation: 此监听器容器的 JMS 客户端 ID。使用持久订阅时必须指定它。

items.source: The following table describes the available configuration options for the JCA variant:
items.translation: 下表描述了 JCA 变体的可用配置选项：

items.source:
The JMS client ID for this listener container. It needs to be specified when using
  durable subscriptions.
items.translation: 此监听器容器的 JMS 客户端 ID。在使用持久订阅时需要指定它。
